title: Regional Director - Quality
text:
Overview

:

**POSITION SUMMARY:** The Regional Director – Quality provides leadership for the assigned platforms’ clinical quality program. In partnership with physician leadership, the Regional Director – Quality supports clinical quality improvement, patient safety, clinician education, and quality governance. The Regional Director – Quality collaborates with facility partners, USAP’s data analytics team, and corporate leadership to advance quality initiatives and support physician-led clinical excellence.

Job Highlights

:

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**: (*The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation)*

 

* Leads the platform's clinical quality program in collaboration with physician leadership.
* Supports implementation of local and enterprise quality initiatives.
* Identifies opportunities to improve clinical quality and patient safety.
* Coordinates platform participation in enterprise quality initiatives, as applicable.
* Manages the case review process in collaboration with the local Clinical Quality Committee (CQC).
* Reviews unexpected clinical outcomes, referrals, trends, and other quality concerns.
* Conducts review of clinical events and recommends opportunities for system or practice improvement.
* Escalates issues through established governance pathways, as appropriate.
* Facilitates the development and implementation of quality improvement initiatives.
* Evaluates the effectiveness of quality improvement initiatives.
* Shares best practices across platforms.
* Develops and coordinates clinician education arising from quality initiatives, patient safety activities, case reviews, and other clinically relevant topics identified by the platform CQC.
* Orients new clinicians to the platform’s quality program.
* Supports the development, implementation, and ongoing review of clinical protocols and practice guidelines in collaboration with physician leadership.
* Reviews patient satisfaction feedback and trends to identify opportunities to improve clinical quality and patient safety.
* Partners with the data analytics team to define quality reporting needs, including relevant dashboards.
* Identifies data-informed opportunities for improvement in collaboration with the platform CQC.
* Supports the platform CQC.
* Partners with facility quality and physician leaders to advance quality initiatives, including representing the platform on facility quality committees, as appropriate.
* Coordinates quality reporting required by facility and payor contracts and applicable regulatory agencies.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

:

**K****NOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES** **(KSAs):**

 

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare or related field required, master’s degree preferred.
* 5+ years’ progressively responsible healthcare quality experience, preferably in a physician practice, ambulatory, or perioperative setting.
* Knowledge of quality improvement principles and patient safety.
* Knowledge of Power BI preferred.
* Knowledge of healthcare regulatory and accreditation requirements relevant to physician practice.
* Knowledge of clinical quality review methodologies and quality governance processes.
* Ability to interpret quality data and trends.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to lead and facilitate committee discussions and communicate complex information to diverse audiences.
* Ability to build collaborative relationships with clinicians, facility leaders, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience leading quality improvement initiatives across multiple sites.
* Demonstrated ability to influence through collaboration and trust building.
* Demonstrated commitment to professionalism, integrity, confidentiality, and continuous improvement.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and developing a high-performing team.

* *The physical demands described here are representative of those that may need to be met by an employee to successfully p**er**form the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* *Occasional Standing*
* *Occasional Walking*
* *Frequent Sitting*
* *Frequent hand, finger movement*
* *Use office equipment (in office or remote)*
* *Communicate verbally and in writing*
